name: _controls.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  carousel/_controls.scss — the controls row and prev/next arrow buttons:
//  WebGL canvas overlay, arrow glyphs, and the countdown progress ring.
//  Imported by carousel.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_CAROUSEL} {
  // ── Controls row ──────────────────────────────────────────
  &-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-lg);
    width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem(calc(($un-768 - $grid-max-area-768) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem(calc(($un-1024 - $grid-max-area-1024) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem(calc(($un-1440 - $grid-max-area-1440) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem(calc(($un-1920 - $grid-max-area-1920) / 2));
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem(calc(($un-2560 - $grid-max-area-2560) / 2));
    }
  }

  // ── Nav buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-btn {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: to-rem(40);
    height: to-rem(40);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    transition: color 0.2s ease;

    @include layout-1024() {
      width: to-rem(48);
      height: to-rem(48);
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      width: $carousel-btn-size;
      height: $carousel-btn-size;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    &-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      display: block;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    &:has(&-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
      & > .#{$_B_CAROUSEL}-btn-arrow,
      & > .#{$_B_CAROUSEL}-btn-ring {
        display: none;
      }
    }

    &-arrow {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      line-height: 1;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    &--prev:hover &-arrow,
    &--prev:focus &-arrow {
      transform: translateX(to-rem(-4));
    }

    &--next:hover &-arrow,
    &--next:focus &-arrow {
      transform: translateX(to-rem(4));
    }

    &:active &-arrow {
      transform: scale(0.85);
    }

    // Countdown ring SVG overlay
    &-ring {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      transform: rotate(-90deg);
      pointer-events: none;

      &-track {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--grey-3);
        stroke-width: $ring-stroke;
        opacity: 0.4;
      }

      &-fill {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--grey);
        stroke-width: $ring-stroke;
        stroke-linecap: round;
      }
    }
  }
}
